prompt: Turn this sketch into a photorealistic industrial-design studio product render of a compact handheld camera, same 3/4 front view, proportions and composition as the sketch, hand grip on the left. Concept: a gravitational well, light falling into a black hole. Core body: deep matte black light-absorbing paint. The whole front face of the black core is sculpted as a smooth curved funnel: the surface bends inward in a deep, continuous hyperbolic curve like warped spacetime, flat at the outer edges and sinking steeply toward the center, forming a deep vortex-shaped well. Soft inflated light-grey tubes in satin soft-touch paint form a rounded hand grip on the left, run up over the top, twist and cross each other between the two top blocks, then flow down onto the front face and follow the curvature of the funnel, bending, stretching and narrowing as they slide down the slope and spiral inward toward the center, as if falling in. At the very bottom of the funnel, deep inside, sits a real camera lens about 35 mm in diameter: black anodized lens barrel with fine knurling, dark coated glass front element with subtle concentric reflections of the inner elements and a faint purple-green coating sheen. All solid painted material: no LED, no glow, no emitted light. Details: dark rectangular viewfinder block top rear left; dark cylindrical dial block top right with knurled black cap; round black domed shutter button on top of the grip, clearly visible; small USB-C port clearly visible on the left outer side face of the grip in a black inset panel. Crisp continuous surfaces, clean part lines, reads as a 3D-printed and painted design model. One single camera fully in frame, centered, seamless pure white background, large softbox key light from upper left, soft contact shadow, high-end product photography, sharp focus. No text, no logos, no watermark, no glowing ring, no extra objects, no hands.
